retrieval_text:
INCIDENT TYPE:
WEB SHELL

DESCRIPTION:
Attackers upload malicious scripts to web servers to obtain persistent remote access and execute commands remotely.

THREAT FRAMEWORK:
- MITRE ATT&CK | T1505.003 | Web Shell

INDICATORS:
- Unknown PHP files
- Suspicious POST requests
- Base64 encoded payloads
- Unexpected outbound connections
- Web process spawning shells

DETECTION RULES:
- Web process spawning cmd.exe
- Unexpected file creation
- Suspicious POST requests

AFFECTED ASSETS:
- Web servers
- Application servers
title: WEB SHELL
